entries.author: Michael Parry
entries.text:
The spirit of the antichrist was alive in the first century. When the Lord returns to cleanse the earth, he will be opposed by religious authorities . Ironically, in their rejection, they will call Him the antichrist.
Dissension was also alive in the first century ecclesia. There were strong-willed, self-important characters such as Diotrephes who wreaked havoc. John was determined to confront Diotrephes. We, too, should not be shy to confront those who would disrupt the peace of Christ's body in their preaching false doctrine or showing bad behaviour.

entries.author: Michael Parry
entries.text: It is just as important to oppose un-Christ like leaders today as it was in the first century.
